text: Peace and quiet! Well — cold quiet. 130 bolts. Say, what year IS it? ...You already left. Classic 40,000-years-ago behavior.
Excuse me! Is it Tuesday? Is it 40,000 years later? The frozen security bots keep 'greeting' me with LASERS. Thaw three permanently, would you?
Another one just thawed and shot at me. Is that in my plan? Is shooting a PREMIUM feature?
The thaw glitch scattered my complimentary slippers across the glacier. Three of them. A man cannot rebuild his dignity barefoot, mechanic.
120 bolts and my eternal, slightly-confused gratitude.
Still one slipper short. My left foot has filed a complaint.
The subscription included slippers. It did NOT include CONTEXT. 130 bolts if you help.
REUNITED! All three! I am once again a man of leisure. 120 bolts. See you on the next planet — I seem to keep... showing up.
